commands.name: direction_h6104
commands.layout: [0]=direction byte (2 up,1 down,4 left,3 right,5 in,6 out,8 max->min,7 min->max,10 CW,9 CCW,11..20 stretch/loop)

commands.name: gradual_change_h6160
commands.payload: A3 00 01 <count> 01 ... / data A3 <i> <17B> / end A3 FF
commands.layout: Gradual4BleWifiController value={0|1}; wrapped by 0xA3 V1 packetiser

commands.name: multi_diy_write
commands.payload: start A5 02 00 <packCount> 00 | data A5 02 <i> <16B> | end A5 02 FF

commands.name: multi_scenes_v1
commands.payload: start A3 00 01 <packCount> 01 <bigNum> <cur+1> <8B verify> <4B> | data A3 <i> <17B> | end A3 FF <last>
commands.layout: value = base64-decoded effect blob from ScenesRgb; attributes direction/x/y/speed in controller

commands.name: multi_new_music
commands.payload:
start A3 00 01 41

... | data | end A3 FF

commands.name: submode_color_8b
commands.payload: 02 R G B flag R2 G2 B2

commands.name: submode_color_9b
commands.payload: 0D R G B kHi kLo R2 G2 B2
commands.layout: RGB + kelvin big-endian + background RGB (9 bytes)

commands.name: submode_music_0e
commands.layout: V1 music; auto inverted (0 when auto); V2 new-code form 0E code sens

commands.name: submode_music_0f
commands.payload: 0F effect sens param auto [R G B]

commands.name: submode_music_13
commands.payload: 13 effect sens param auto [R G B]

commands.name: submode_video_00
commands.layout: h6101 videoType 0=part,1=all,2=dynamic; h6104 adds brightness byte

notifications.name: wifi_connect
notifications.layout: [0]==0 -> connected; 0x11 is notify type after proType 0xEE

iot.envelope: Write/AbsCmdWrite V0 for h6104/h6159/h6160/h6182; V1 (state/op) for homelightv1/stringlightv2/H6085-89

other_protocols.name: softAP provisioning (H6085/H6086/H6089)
other_protocols.details: SSID prefix Govee_bulb_<SKU>, device 192.168.1.1 port 7200, JSON BaseRequest/BaseResponse: type 1 read device info, type 2 send WifiApInfo; then CheckDeviceWifiRequest/DeviceBindRequest/DeviceTopicRequest bootstrap. No BLE.

other_protocols.name: MQTT/cloud (IoT)
other_protocols.details: After provisioning, device bound to account topic; DeviceSetting{mac,topic} used for IoT publish/subscribe; online cmd 'online'.

other_protocols.name: BLE advertisement matching
other_protocols.details: BleBroadcastProcessorV1 (rgblight, carlightv1, homelightv1) matches advertisements to SKU for connect dialog; no telemetry parsing in this split.

other_protocols.name: group / multi-device
other_protocols.details: BleCommGroup/BleMultiCommGroup + GroupOp; group code g()=3; secret key via SecretKeyController; response match frame[0]==0xAA && frame[1]==0x01 -> frame[2]!=0.

dynamic_effects.name: colour (8-byte)
dynamic_effects.payload: 02 R G B flag R2 G2 B2

dynamic_effects.name: colour + kelvin (9-byte)
dynamic_effects.payload: 0D R G B kHi kLo R2 G2 B2

dynamic_effects.name: music V2 (new codes)
dynamic_effects.payload: 0E musicCode sens | 0E auto sens manualFlag R G B

dynamic_effects.name: music (home light)
dynamic_effects.payload: 0F effect sens param auto [R G B]

dynamic_effects.name: music (new, 0x13)
dynamic_effects.payload: 13 effect sens param auto [R G B]

notes: Effect blobs for 0xA3 multi-scene are runtime base64 payloads from the effect library (ScenesRgb/ScenesRgbIC/ScenesGraffiti/ScenesCube/ScenesCompose/ScenesH610B) and cannot be statically enumerated. H7004/H7017 only expose the 0x0D red/blue ratio in this split. stringlightv2 transport depends on runtime goodsType (1/40/108 = ble+iot, 2/39/68/78/143 = ble). H6138/H6139 are classified ble+iot via the shared h6159 IoT builders/Ble.u() ptReal, although their own EffectOp4Ble is BLE-only. New-music code list (AbsNewMusicEffect.newMusicCode4RgbList) is runtime data. Only notify type 0x11 (WiFi connect) is handled by BleNotifyComm in this split. ptUrl/multiSync/OTA transfer are not implemented here (only 0xEE OTA-prepare).
